title: No Way Out
summary: Wang Lin confronts the Da Lou Sword Sect disciples at the abyss exit, takes a zodiac sword from one who attacks him, and their leader Chen Long hands it over as an apology. Chen Long introduces Tan Lang, a senior of their masters' generation, who supposedly can only use late Ascendant strength because the mosquito beasts wounded him, but Wang Lin sees that Tan Lang is faking and that he lured the beasts here himself. When the violet fog merges, Tan Lang sacrifices the sword disciples' flesh, blood and souls to bring down the Tidal Token. Zhou Yi offers to carry Wang Lin out, but Wang Lin holds on for ten more breaths and seizes swords and loot, then he and Chen Long gang up on Tan Lang. Tan Lang answers with Devour Death, a Mountain Soul torn from the Immortal Realm, the Celestial Scent, the Ancient God Tu Si cauldron, Axis Inversion and his Atlas Seal, and Wang Lin grabs the token anyway. Tan Lang then releases his second soul, and when Wang Lin breaks its controlling mark it turns out to be a free Ancient Thunder Dragon, which Wang Lin faces with the Net-Severing Sword Art.
